verses.6: And hath made us kings and priests unto God and his Father; to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.7: Behold, he cometh with clouds; and every eye shall see him, and they also which pierced him: and all kindreds of the earth shall wail because of him. Even so, Amen.
verses.10: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet,
verses.12: And I turned to see the voice that spake with me. And being turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks;
verses.13: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one like unto the Son of man, clothed with a garment down to the foot, and girt about the paps with a golden girdle.
verses.14: His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
verses.15: And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace; and his voice as the sound of many waters.
verses.16: And he had in his right hand seven stars: and out of his mouth went a sharp twoedged sword: and his countenance was as the sun shineth in his strength.
